title: Hobbies
intro: Here's a snippet into some of my hobbies! I love to keep busy and have my hands in a little bit of everything. 🐝

items.blurb: I've been trying to learn piano! I played briefly as a kid, but basically started from nothing. I like very peaceful, uncomplicated piano, like Satie, Austin Farwell, Idealism, etc.
I have a dream to one day own an Ooni or a Gozney 😭. Vegetarian so this is a tofu buffalo chicken!
